svg.title: Paired Neurospora life cycles
svg.desc: Two source schematic mating-type cycles. Green A and purple a hyphae exchange conidia, form diploid zygote nuclei and undergo first meiosis, second meiosis and mitotic divisions. Both final asci contain eight spores ordered AAAAaaaa. No crossover event is inferred. Conidial and hyphal counts are illustrative.
